fact: ICASEES published the Education - Annuaire Statistique 2023-2024 (EDU_AS_2023-2024.pdf) on 5 August 2026, a further edition of the education ministry's school statistics yearbook series after the 2021-2022 one (the page itself shows only file metadata, so the school-return source is inferred from the series).
title: Education - Annuaire Statistique 2023-2024
